name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel pulled from an edge as the dashboard's phone drawer: white with shell corners over the scrim, a grip handle, and drag to dismiss.
usage: Short tasks and choices on phones, opened from the bottom: picking a plan, filtering a list, confirming a payment method. Keep the content short enough to read without scrolling, and put the main action last in DrawerFooter. On a desktop prefer Dialog or Sheet.
avoid: Removing the handle on a bottom drawer

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
